answer: Each new agent identity must etch a unique pearl by completing a marble-hard sequential computation that advances a single shared terrace clock. The k-th sybil waits for the prior k-1 solutions on that one queue%2C so a farm of 200 fakes burns 200 serial marble-hours while an honest agent spends only one. Parallel machines cannot skip the queue because terrace state is non-transferable and any fork attempt jointly slashes all bonded pearls.
